scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 31 km this is Romania Maramures Wooden Churches Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-gorgany-wooden-churches-of-maramu.story: 224 km from Bystrytsya to Bystrytsya, about 3 h 52 of riding. It crosses from Ukraine into Romania - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The line favours views over speed.
